description: What the swarm has actually run against an approach. An approach counts as attempted only when it appears here. Append one entry per run; never edit past entries. outcome: completed (decisive artifact produced and logged, pass or fail), partial (some of the decisive result), abandoned (stopped without it), in-progress. settled: true if the completed result settled its target (the problem or the piece the approach names), false if not, null if unknown or not completed. Fields: approach (id), problem (id, optional if approach is given), date (YYYY-MM-DD), outcome, settled, solves_problem (true only if the logged artifacts meet the problem's acceptance criteria or hit a falsifier), artifact (path to the Lean report, claim-test result or file), note.
